---
title: "A block that turns the chrome off"
filters:
  - code-window
---

The block below turns the chrome off for itself, and writes every other
attribute the extension reads. None of them belongs in the rendered document.

```{.python filename="a.py" code-window-enabled="false" code-window-style="windows" code-window-collapse="open" code-window-lines="1,2" code-window-no-auto-filename="true"}
x = 1
```
